commit.message: feat(memory): transfer memories with reviewed import (MAGI-015)

specification.objective: MAGI-015: explicitly export selected stored memory to a versioned local JSON file and import only validated, reviewed additions through a preview and explicit confirmation.

requirements.statement: Export selected memory, user memory, or both locally as JSON with format_version, target and entries; disclose privacy and never upload exports to external servers.
Parse only the defined JSON format and reject malformed, oversized, incompatible, duplicate, delimiter-containing, or over-budget data before any store mutation.
Show add-only preview counts and diffs, require explicit user confirmation, bind preview to current-store fingerprints, and apply through Hermes MemoryStore public batch operations.
Report per-target partial results and document concurrency and multi-target atomicity limitations; preserve existing entries on validation failures.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Valid Unicode and multiline data round-trip in versioned JSON; export download is generated locally and visibly warns about private contents.
Invalid schema, size, delimiter, duplicates, and budget failures are rejected before mutations, and preview selects only missing entries.
No write is made before explicit confirmation; stale preview conflicts and partial target outcomes are visible, and docs state concurrency/atomicity limits.

invariants.statement: No import validation failure may change either memory target; import adds missing entries only and never replaces existing entries.
Magi does not transmit exported files to external services or treat imported text as executable instructions.

forbidden_states.statement: Silent import, automatic overwrite, unbounded file/payload processing, or data mutation before full target validation.
Export data sent to an external server or import text interpreted as code, prompts, or instructions.

inputs.statement: A user-selected target and JSON document with format_version, target, and entries, bounded by explicit byte, entry, and character limits.

outputs.statement: A local JSON download or an add-only preview with counts/diffs, snapshot fingerprint, and explicit per-target apply result.

failure_semantics.statement: Malformed, excessive, incompatible, duplicate, delimiter, budget, or stale input returns a clear error without mutation; independent targets may partially succeed only after explicit confirmation and must report each outcome.
